findings.title: Validate the bounded witness arguments before boot or mutation
findings.mechanism: tonumber outputs are not checked for finite/range/integer constraints. frame_ms=0 is accepted by Engine::frame and never advances elapsed_seconds, so positive warmup at69 loops indefinitely; an infinite/very large window yields an unbounded/excessive numeric frame loop. At99 explicit segment=abc becomes nil then falls back to-1, silently selecting and killing the first qualifying segment instead of rejecting the requested invalid index.
findings.correction: Before boot/output/mutation validate finite nonnegative warmup/window_seconds, strictly positive integer frame_ms within the engine range, a finite maximum total frame budget, supported criterion0, and explicit bridge/segment integer ranges. Distinguish absent selectors from invalid numeric strings; invalid explicit segment must not become auto. Add caller-level invalid-argument controls which assert no boot/fail operation occurred.
findings.planned_fixed_arguments: Root5s/100ms/12s/criterion0 are valid; this is fixture input/safety behavior, not bridge physics.

findings.title: Qualify the claimed first-kill/unsupported-neighbour preconditions
findings.mechanism: Criterion0 requires the selected non-U segment alive, but tests only the adjacent segment subtype U, not its alive flag; survey/script also do not require parent bridge alive. An already-dead unsupported neighbour will not enter br_msgs unsupported-kill again, and a bridge already dead will not increment link breaks/create first repair task again. These are not guaranteed by first_candidate>=0, despite the definite statement at48 and one-run coverage list.
findings.correction: Either select an alive bridge and living adjacent unsupported segment for the intended first-collapse case, or emit/check those facts and explicitly qualify span-kill/link-break/repair coverage as reached only when the corresponding original branch/events occur. A bounded window also does not guarantee landing at an unknown initial height. No need to invent or force unsupported retail geometry.

disposition: One fixture argument-safety P2 and one bounded precondition/coverage P3; original physical formulas unchanged. Planned native remains unrun and is not accepted by this source review.
